every_position_composed.reason: Both sites feature identical camera paths and staging from frame 1 through frame 9.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D assembly-line metaphor across frames 1 to 9 to illustrate log compression, storage, and line anchoring.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: In frames 1 through 9, the lighter slate floor of site 1 makes contact shadows and the dark machine frames clearly visible, whereas site 2's dark floor swallows the dark metalwork.

type_and_layout.reason: Across frames 1 to 9, site 2's darker, lower-contrast floor grid reduces background clutter and blends more seamlessly with the dark UI cards.

overall.reason: Although the two sites are nearly identical in layout and animation, site 1's brighter floor plane grounds the dark 3D machinery and preserves its silhouette and shadows much better.
